title: Limits and errors
content:
# Limits and errors

The per-user burst limit and Google quota on live Google Ads calls, what the Google Ads API and Zernio's integration do not expose, and the errors Google returns most often.

Live Google Ads calls pass a per-user burst limit. Anything Google rejects comes back carrying Google's own error.

## API version

Zernio calls Google Ads API `v25`, so GAQL resource and field names resolve against that version.

Zernio moves the version itself, and a migration needs no change on your side. The one field Google removed that older queries still use is translated for you, see [legacy date fields](/platforms/google-ads/analytics#legacy-date-fields).

## Quotas and the ops budget

Every Google Ads API call across all Zernio customers runs on one developer token.

The token holds Standard access, so there is no daily operations cap to budget for. Two limits remain:

| Limit | What it is | 429 `details` |
|---|---|---|
| Per-user burst | Zernio's own gate on user-driven live calls (the GAQL passthrough, search terms, Keyword Planner, and the keyword, label, goal, asset group, recommendation, targeting and campaign writes that go straight to Google): 15 requests per minute per Google Ads account and 120 per minute per user across all accounts, counted per request regardless of batch size | `budgetScope: "account"` or `"user"`. Clears within a minute. |
| Google's quota | Google throttling the shared developer token or your own ad account | `quotaExhausted: true`, `quotaScope` (`DEVELOPER` for the shared token, `ACCOUNT` for your ad account) and `resetsAt`, with a `Retry-After` header counting down to it |

Both return `429` with code `rate_limited` and `platform: "google"`.

On a Google quota `429`, retrying before `resetsAt` cannot succeed. Keep calling other platforms, which are unaffected.

**Cached reads.** These reads are cached for 10 minutes:

- labels
- asset groups
- conversion goals
- recommendations
- the manager hierarchy
- negative keyword lists
- search terms

When Google's quota runs out, they fall back to the last successful copy with `stale: true`. Check `cachedAt` and `stale` before treating a read as live.

[Rate limits](/guides/rate-limits) covers Zernio's own request limits.

## What you cannot do

Google's API, or Zernio's Google integration, does not expose:

- Shopping or Video campaigns through `/v1/ads/create` (Search, Display, Performance Max and [Demand Gen](/platforms/google-ads/demand-gen) only). Discovered campaigns of every type still sync into `/ads/tree` with metrics. A discovered Video campaign ad carries its YouTube video ids in `creative.youtubeVideoIds`, with the first video's YouTube thumbnail as `creative.thumbnailUrl`.
- Editing the cards of an existing Demand Gen carousel ad (create a new carousel ad instead).
- Deleting a Google asset: unlinking or removing detaches it, and the asset stays in the account library.
- A Responsive Display Ad with one image (Google requires landscape and square).
- GAQL writes: the passthrough is read-only `SELECT`.
- `segments.date` without a finite date filter (Google rejects it).
- Campaign-level negative keywords on `GET /v1/ads/keywords` (ad-group level only; read them from `GET /v1/ads/campaigns/{campaignId}/negative-keywords` or GAQL).
- Same-day keyword sync: the synced keyword list refreshes about once a day per customer.
- Phone-number matching on Customer Match (email only; `phone` is ignored).
- Instant conversions: Data Manager conversions take up to 3 hours to appear in reports.

## Common errors

| Error | Where | Cause and fix |
|---|---|---|
| `NOT_ENOUGH_SQUARE_MARKETING_IMAGE_ASSET`, `NOT_ENOUGH_MARKETING_IMAGE_ASSET` | Display create | One of the 2 required images is missing. Pass both `images.landscape` and `images.square`. |
| `400` carrying a GAQL message | GAQL passthrough | Google's query validator, verbatim; its messages name the offending field. The classic is an unbounded `segments.date`. |
| `429` with `details.budgetScope: "account"` or `"user"` | Any live Google call | You passed 15 requests in a minute on one account (`account`) or 120 across all your accounts (`user`). Retry within the minute. |
| `429` with `details.quotaExhausted: true` | Any live Google call | Google's quota on the shared token (`quotaScope: DEVELOPER`) or your ad account (`ACCOUNT`). Wait until `details.resetsAt`. |

Google's own error is forwarded inside Zernio's `platform_error` envelope ([error handling](/guides/error-handling)):

```json
{
  "error": "Google rejected the ad: NOT_ENOUGH_SQUARE_MARKETING_IMAGE_ASSET",
  "type": "platform_error",
  "code": "platform_api_error",
  "platform": "google",
  "platformError": {
    "code": 3,
    "message": "Request contains an invalid argument.",
    "details": [ { "errors": [ { "errorCode": { "assetError": "NOT_ENOUGH_SQUARE_MARKETING_IMAGE_ASSET" }, "message": "Too few." } ] } ]
  }
}
```
